_comment: Source registry (plan §7.5 stage 0). fetch.py downloads each input into cache/, computes sha256 and pins it here on first run; later runs fail if the bytes change. Update a pin only deliberately: python3 fetch.py --repin <id>.

shamela_istilah.version: page text as extracted by fetch.py (terms.extract_shamela) on the retrieval date; the extracted text is the pinned version
shamela_istilah.options: A Shamela page's HTML carries per-request tokens, so the EXTRACTED TEXT is pinned (sha256 of the UTF-8 .txt under cache_dir), not the HTML: the matn paragraphs of <div class="nass">, then the editor's footnotes (p.hamesh) after a line '[هامش]'. Authoring and validation input only: nothing from these pages is shipped except the term spellings they attest; the authored term table keeps excerpts of at most 12 words.
